title: Bedroom or study major opening offset 1.5 m from a parallel adjoining opening
text: Notwithstanding C3.10.2, a major opening to a bedroom or study may be offset a minimum of 1.5m from a parallel major opening on an adjoining property, measured from the edge of one major opening to another (refer Figure 3.10g).

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.10.3. Bedroom and study openings only; measured edge to edge between parallel openings. May not address overlooking of other floor levels (p47 note). Applies to sources with a floor level more than 0.5 m above NGL; the cone radius includes the width of any adjoining ROW, communal street or battleaxe leg (p47 note). C3.10.4 applies C3.10.1-C3.10.3 between grouped dwellings on the same lot. Vacant or unknown adjoining sites are C3.10.5. Coding excludes R100-SL: Chapter 3 Table 2.10a (p26) removes all 3.10 provisions for R100-SL; its footnote restores them where the adjoining property is not R100-SL (not encoded).
